article_title: Sapporo to move some beer production from Canada to US after tariffs

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: Sapporo moving some production to the US in response to higher tariffs on Canadian beer
Sapporo ending all beer sales outside Japan
Canada buying a Japanese brewery to reduce alcohol prices
Carlsberg closing every brewery in Southeast Asia
tasks.correct_answer: Sapporo moving some production to the US in response to higher tariffs on Canadian beer
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מסבירה כיצד מכס של 50% על בירה המיובאת מקנדה גורם לסאפורו להעביר חלק מן הייצור לארה״ב.

tasks.prompt: Which product does Sapporo plan to move from Canadian to US production by the first half of 2027?
options: Its flagship alcoholic beer sold only in Japan
Beer made for the Danish market
Its non-alcoholic beer for US customers
Every product made by Sleeman Breweries
tasks.correct_answer: Its non-alcoholic beer for US customers
tasks.explanation_hebrew: החברה מתכננת להעביר לארה״ב את ייצור הבירה ללא אלכוהול שמיוצרת כיום בקנדה עבור לקוחות אמריקאים.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “mitigate rising costs” mean?
options: Measure the costs without changing them
Reduce or limit the effect of the higher costs
Transfer all costs to Canadian employees
Publish the costs in several currencies
tasks.correct_answer: Reduce or limit the effect of the higher costs
tasks.explanation_hebrew: mitigate פירושו לצמצם או לרכך את ההשפעה; כאן מדובר בהקטנת נזקי העלויות שנגרמו מן המכסים.

tasks.prompt: What options is Sapporo considering for adding production capacity on the US West Coast?
options: Building or buying a brewery, or using a third-party manufacturer
Importing more Canadian beer through Europe
Selling its US subsidiary to Carlsberg
Producing beer only in Japanese restaurants
tasks.correct_answer: Building or buying a brewery, or using a third-party manufacturer
tasks.explanation_hebrew: האפשרויות המוזכרות הן בנייה או רכישה של מבשלה, או שותפות עם יצרן חיצוני.

tasks.prompt: Why is overseas expansion particularly important to Sapporo?
options: Japan has banned the sale of non-alcoholic beer
The US requires every foreign brewer to own a factory
Its partnership with Carlsberg applies only inside Japan
Japan's shrinking population has weakened domestic alcohol sales
tasks.correct_answer: Japan's shrinking population has weakened domestic alcohol sales
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הירידה באוכלוסיית יפן מכבידה על מכירות האלכוהול המקומיות, ולכן צמיחה בשווקים בחו״ל חשובה יותר לחברה.

tasks.prompt: What does “earmarked” mean in the statement that 30% of the capital is earmarked for overseas markets?
options: Lost because of exchange rates
Set aside for a particular purpose
Borrowed from Canadian customers
Spent entirely before 2026
tasks.correct_answer: Set aside for a particular purpose
tasks.explanation_hebrew: earmarked פירושו שיועד או הוקצה מראש למטרה מסוימת; כאן 30% מן ההון מיועדים לשווקים מעבר לים.
